title: BiomeTransition
description: Validates a biome transition file defining objects and gradients at biome boundaries

biome_a.description: First biome ID (lexicographically first in canonical ordering)

blend_width.description: Width of the transition zone in tiles

edge_objects.description: Objects that appear specifically at the boundary edge

density.description: Placement probability 0-1 per eligible edge tile

gradient_settings.description: Controls how each biome's objects fade in/out across the transition zone

biome_a_objects.description: Density gradient curve for biome_a objects moving toward biome_b

biome_b_objects.description: Density gradient curve for biome_b objects moving toward biome_a
